summary: This short note on the 1992 US Open women's doubles says that Pam Shriver and Natasha Zvereva were the defending champions. It adds that both competed with different partners that year: Shriver with Martina Navratilova and Zvereva with Gigi Fernández. The note contains no further results, scores or details.
one_line: Note on the 1992 US Open women's doubles, where defending champions Pam Shriver and Natasha Zvereva played with new partners.
key_facts: Pam Shriver and Natasha Zvereva were the defending champions of the 1992 US Open women's doubles.
In 1992, Pam Shriver competed with Martina Navratilova.
In 1992, Natasha Zvereva competed with Gigi Fernández.
Pam Shriver and Natasha Zvereva competed with different partners in 1992 than they had as defending champions.
